name: SocialLinks - On Dark, No Badges
description: The footer's row, which appears on every page of the site. It shows the one decision separating the two variants: on dark there is no white badge behind each mark, because a white circle on the footer's ink reads as a hole punched in the band. The marks are not in brand colours here either, since the X mark is black and would vanish; they inherit the surrounding light text instead.
